senses.meaning: Go from one place/person to another; circulate

senses.meaning: Leave a place or event, especially suddenly or angrily

senses.meaning: Decide not to do or say STH

senses.meaning: Prevent SB/STH from reaching their full potential

senses.meaning: Prevent SB/STH from going somewhere

senses.meaning: Record information on paper

senses.meaning: Return to a place one has lived in before

senses.meaning: Complete a form or official document

senses.meaning: Rest in a comfortable position against the back of a seat

senses.meaning: (Sit back and do STH) Deliberately take no action/remain passive about STH

senses.meaning: Exclude STH as a possibility, plausible cause or explanation

senses.meaning: Move upward, from a lower spatial location to a higher one

senses.meaning: Choose SB/STH among a number of alternatives

senses.meaning: Detect/be noticed among a group of things or people

senses.meaning: Remove STH that was previously put up or put in place

senses.meaning: Take SB to a place, esp. further south or at a lower level

senses.meaning: (+ with) Continue doing STH after stopping

senses.meaning: Get on board some form of public transportation (train, bus, plane, elevator)
senses.example: He got on the bus to go to school.

senses.meaning: Return STH to its original owner/provider

senses.meaning: Give STH to SB by holding it in one’s hand and offering it to them

senses.meaning: Surrender control or responsibility for STH/SB to SB else, esp. officially

senses.meaning: Express or represent the most important/representative facts, ideas, or characteristics of SB/STH, especially in a brief manner

senses.meaning: Leave one’s place of residence permanently

senses.meaning: Become detached or removed from a larger whole

senses.meaning: Appear or seem to be a particular way

senses.meaning: Be finished with STH; have completed STH

senses.meaning: Circulate or communicate; give STH to SB after receiving it from SB else (information, ideas, object)

senses.meaning: Transmit from one generation to the next (traditions, beliefs, skills, possessions)

senses.meaning: Die (euphemism)

senses.meaning: Provide a place for SB to live or stay

senses.meaning: Fully understand or grasp the meaning of STH

senses.meaning: Deceive by behaving in a dishonest way

senses.meaning: Adopt a quieter and steadier lifestyle

senses.meaning: Become calmer, quieter, more orderly

senses.meaning: Get into a comfortable position, either sitting or lying
senses.example: When he reached the top of the hill, he settled down in the grass to have a rest.

senses.meaning: Come in the area near STH/SB
senses.example: He came around to my room and kissed me goodnight.

senses.meaning: (+ to) Convert to an opinion or decision
senses.example: I believe she will come around to our way of thinking eventually.

senses.meaning: Happen again as a regular event, at its usual time
senses.example: You’ll have to wait until summer comes around.

senses.meaning: (+ for) Do SB’s work temporarily because they cannot or will not do it themselves

senses.meaning: (+ on) Give SB extra or missing information they want or need

senses.meaning: Put material or substance into STH in order to make it full or complete

senses.meaning: Give to each of a large number of people

senses.meaning: Make known openly or publicly

senses.meaning: Collapse/fail; stop functioning properly (heart, knees)

senses.meaning: Cease resistance to (liking/temptation/habit, or to SB’s demands/control)

senses.meaning: Progress or proceed with an activity

senses.meaning: Act in cooperation or express agreement

senses.meaning: Go to a place or event, esp. without much planning

senses.meaning: Separate a part (or become separate) from a larger piece

senses.meaning: Stop speaking, especially suddenly

senses.meaning: Put an end to STH (relationship, discussion, talks, negotiations)
senses.example: They broke off diplomatic relations in 1986.

senses.meaning: Take place or happen/occur, esp. unexpectedly

senses.meaning: Stop operating or functioning

senses.meaning: Put one thing inside another; include or insert
senses.example: You need to put in your contact details in case there is a problem.

senses.meaning: Invest or devote so as to achieve STH (time, effort, work)
senses.example: I put in ten hours a day at the office.

senses.meaning: Begin a course of action, usually with a specific purpose/objective in mind
senses.example: We set about laying the table before our guests arrived.
